key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Keybinding to toggle speech-to-text recording

key.name: abort-recording
key.description: Keybinding to abort recording without transcribing

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Enable verbose logging to ~/.local/share/speech-to-text/debug.log

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: Automatically type the transcribed text at cursor position

key.name: wrap-marker
key.description: Wrap transcribed text with speech-to-text:"..." to provide context to LLMs

key.name: auto-enter
key.description: Send Return/Enter key after auto-pasting (requires auto-paste to be enabled)

key.name: streaming-mode
key.description: Use streaming transcription instead of batch. It does not stop on silence: it stops at Insert or at wsi-stream's fixed streaming limit, or, with continuous dictation in server mode, at the limits set for that. Standard and pre-buffer mode need RealtimeSTT.

key.name: streaming-startup-mode
key.description: Startup mode for streaming: "standard" (load model then start), "pre-buffer" (record while loading), "server" (persistent server for instant startup)

key.name: language
key.description: Language for speech recognition: "system" uses desktop locale, or specify a language code like "en"

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show desktop notifications for recording status and transcription results

key.name: whisper-model
key.description: Whisper model to use for transcription: "auto" (with an NVIDIA GPU: distil-large-v3.5 for English, large-v3-turbo otherwise; without one: base for streaming, small for batch; resolved by wsi-resolve-model), or a model name such as "small", "large-v3-turbo" or "distil-large-v3.5" (English only)

key.name: toggle-recording-claude
key.description: Keybinding to toggle speech-to-text recording with Claude Code post-processing (professional/corporate style)

key.name: toggle-recording-claude-natural
key.description: Keybinding to toggle speech-to-text recording with Claude Code post-processing (natural/personal style)

key.name: claude-enabled
key.description: Post-process transcriptions through Claude Code for reformatting and cleanup

key.name: claude-model
key.description: Claude model to use for post-processing: "sonnet" (balanced), "opus" (best quality), "haiku" (fastest)

key.name: claude-token
key.description: The account Claude post-processing runs as: the name of a token in ~/.claude-tokens/ccy/tokens/ (NAME.YYYY-MM-DD.token, made by ccy --create-token, as cc and ccy use), of which the newest unexpired file is used. Empty uses the desktop login, which cc parks aside while a named-token session runs, so post-processing fails then. Read by wsi-claude-process at each run.

key.name: stop-grace-seconds
key.description: After the first stop press (Insert), keep recording for this many seconds so the last words are captured, then stop. A second press during the grace stops at once; Escape still discards at once. 0 stops immediately. Read by the recorder scripts via wsi-stop-grace.

key.name: server-idle-timeout-minutes
key.description: Streaming server mode: the warm server shuts down after this many minutes without a recording. 0 keeps it running until logout. Passed by wsi-stream when it starts the server, so a change applies from the next server start.

key.name: server-start-at-login
key.description: Streaming server mode: start the warm server when you log in, so the first recording is not a cold start. Only acts when streaming mode is on with startup mode "server". Run by the user unit wsi-stream-server-at-login.service; applies from the next login.

key.name: continuous-dictation
key.description: Streaming server mode: dictate for as long as you like. The server transcribes each phrase while you speak and pastes the whole text once at stop. The recording stops at Insert, after the no-speech time below, or at the maximum length. Off: server mode stops at the fixed streaming limit, as the other streaming modes do. Read by wsi-stream at each recording.

key.name: max-recording-minutes
key.description: Continuous dictation: the recording stops and is transcribed after this many minutes, as a last resort against a forgotten microphone. The panel counts down in the last minute.

key.name: silence-autostop-seconds
key.description: Continuous dictation: stop and transcribe after this many seconds without speech. 0 never stops for silence.

key.name: paste-default-mode
key.description: The paste key for an app that is not a terminal and not in the Ctrl+V list: "no-shift" for Ctrl+V (what GUI toolkits bind), "with-shift" for Ctrl+Shift+V. A terminal (an app whose desktop entry has the TerminalEmulator category) always gets Ctrl+Shift+V. Chosen at each paste, for the window focused then.

key.name: paste-ctrl-v-apps
key.description: Comma-separated WM_CLASS names of apps that always paste with Ctrl+V, ahead of every other rule

key.name: paste-save-apps
key.description: Comma-separated WM_CLASS names of apps that get Ctrl+S after each paste (and after its Enter), e.g. org.gnome.TextEditor. Never sent to a terminal, where Ctrl+S freezes the screen. Empty by default: in a browser Ctrl+S saves the page, and an untitled document opens a Save dialog.

key.name: dictation-paste-interval-seconds
key.description: Continuous dictation: paste the text transcribed so far every this many seconds, into the window focused at that moment, so it appears while you speak. Enter follows only the last paste, at stop. 0 pastes the whole text once at stop. Not used with Claude post-processing, which needs the whole text. Read by wsi-stream at each recording.
